label: Orbital Slingshot Maneuver
caption: Interactive orbital mechanics lab: master orbital insertion, Jupiter gravity assists, and Martian atmospheric aerobraking.

steps.title: Step 1: Orbital Insertion
steps.instruction: Aim the initial velocity $v_0$ (drag the spacecraft or crosshair reticle) so Earth's gravity curves your trajectory to dock with **Station Alpha**.
steps.voice: Aim the launch vector from Earth so gravity curves the flight path directly to dock with Station Alpha.
steps.feedback: Orbital insertion achieved! Earth's gravitational pull curved the trajectory into an elliptical transfer arc, successfully docking with Station Alpha.
steps.hint: Angle the vector slightly downward so Earth's gravity curves your trajectory right into Station Alpha's docking port.

steps.title: Step 2: Jupiter Gravity Assist
steps.instruction: Aim the spacecraft below **Jupiter** to execute a hyperbolic gravity assist slingshot into **Outpost Gamma**.
steps.voice: Aim the spacecraft below Jupiter to execute a gravity assist slingshot into Deep Space Outpost Gamma.
steps.feedback: Slingshot confirmed! By diving through Jupiter's deep gravity well and exiting along its orbital path, the spacecraft accelerated to deep space escape velocity.
steps.hint: Pass closely underneath Jupiter without hitting its surface. Exiting forward along its trajectory transfers maximum momentum.

steps.title: Step 3: Atmospheric Aerobraking
steps.instruction: Skim through **Mars's glowing upper atmosphere** to dissipate hyper-orbital kinetic energy into heat, capturing the spacecraft into a permanent **Low Mars Orbit**.
steps.voice: Skim through Mars's upper atmosphere to dissipate excess kinetic energy and capture the spacecraft into orbit.
steps.feedback: Aerobraking successful! Atmospheric friction safely converted excess hyper-orbital kinetic energy into heat, capturing the spacecraft into Low Mars Orbit.
steps.hint: Aim through the glowing red atmosphere ring without crashing into Mars. Atmospheric aerobraking will circularize the orbit.
